backfillModal.goBackOnlyAsFar: Go back only as far as the session you played with this playstyle. Anything earlier pulls in plays set with your normal one — which is exactly what a separate profile exists to keep out.
backfillModal.onlyImportPlaysThatMatch: Only import plays that match my play tracking filter
backfillModal.playsSetWhileThisApp: Plays set while this app was closed were never tracked. Choose how far back to look and they will be imported from that moment onward — finished plays from their replays, and quits, fails and retries from osu!lazer’s own logs.
countryRank.title: Not shown: the offline player sample is far too thin to estimate a per-country rank
filterModal.offByDefaultAndEvery: Off by default, and every play is tracked. Turning it on changes nothing on its own: every criterion below starts wide open.
filterModal.twoCriteriaCannotJudgeA: Two criteria cannot judge a play that was quit, failed or retried: osu!lazer records no mods and no star rating for a play it discards, so those plays are matched on the other seven. That is deliberate — osu! counts them, so this does.
folderRestart: Restart the app for this to take effect — it reads your plays from the folders it was started with.
folders.addFailed: that folder could not be added
folders.loadFailed: Could not read the folder list.
folders.needPath: Type the path to an osu! folder first.
folders.noneAfterSearch: No osu! folder was found, even after searching every drive. Add one below.
folders.removeFailed: that folder could not be removed
folders.searchingHint: Looking through every drive. This takes a few seconds.
folderSearchNote: Your drives have not been searched yet. It takes a few seconds.
foldersModal.pickTheFolderThatHas: Pick the folder that has osu!.exe in it for osu!stable, or the one with client.realm for osu!lazer — not the folder above it.
foldersModal.theFoldersThisAppReads: The folders this app reads your plays from. It finds them by itself on start — in the registry, in your shortcuts, and by searching your drives — but osu! can be installed anywhere, so you can also point at one here.
importQuery.placeholder: username, user id, or profile link
importSection.oneRequestToOsuPpy: One request to osu.ppy.sh to find the account, one per picture, one per hundred favorites, and a few per game mode for scores -- all when you press Import. No login and no API key.
installSettings.openThisPageInYour: Open this page in your browser whenever the app starts. This one is not a profile's: it decides what happens before any profile is on screen, so it is saved for the whole install, in data/config.json.

optLazerScoring.title: Show scores on osu!lazer's scale, where a nomod SS is 1,000,000. Off shows the classic, uncapped scale.

page.notAffiliatedWithOsuOr: Not affiliated with osu! or ppy.
pname.title: Rename this profile
profileEdit.erasesEverythingTrackedForTh: Erases everything tracked for this profile and starts it again from zero. It asks first, and your osu! account and replay files are not touched.
profileEdit.name: Name
profileEdit.twoLetterCodeShownBeside: Two-letter code, shown beside the profile name. Leave empty for none.
profileEdit.whatThisProfileIsTracking: What this profile is tracking. Shown under the name.
profilesModal.eachProfileIsASeparate: Each profile is a separate playstyle with its own scores, pp and level. Only the selected one records the plays you set.
quitBtn.title: Quit osu! local profiles
removedScores.removingAScoreOrA: Removing a score, or a play that was not finished or submitted, never deletes it. Put one back and it returns to every section and to the totals. The red minus deletes one for good: it cannot be put back, and it is never imported again.
resetModal.ppRankAccuracyLevelAnd: pp, rank, accuracy, level and play count return to zero
resetModal.thisCannotBeUndoneReplays: This cannot be undone. Replays stay on disk, but they will not be re-imported: tracking restarts from the moment you confirm.
resetModal.yourOsuAccountAndYour: Your osu! account and your replay files are not touched
scoreClose.label: Close
scoreClose.title: Close
scoreModal.label: Score details
sharedSection.keepFavoriteBeatmapsTheSam: Keep Favorite Beatmaps the same on every profile
sharedSection.onByDefaultOneList: On by default: one list, shared by every profile. Turn it off and each profile keeps its own copy of the list as it stands; turn it back on and the lists are merged. Nothing is lost either way.
shareModal.aCopyOfTheWhole: A copy of the whole database, every profile included.
shareModal.everyScoreThisProfileHas: Every score this profile has tracked, with its beatmap, plus the computed totals and rank.
shareModal.thisPageAsOneHtml: This page as one .html file that works like it: show more, the mode tabs, View Details and the medals all respond. It opens anywhere without this app, nothing in it can change the profile, and it holds nothing about this computer, so it can be put online as it is.
updateModal.yourTrackedScoresSettingsAnd: Your tracked scores, settings and profile pictures are kept — they live in data/, which an update never touches. The files being replaced are set aside until the new version is in place, so an update that is interrupted can be undone rather than leaving a half-installed app.
welcomeDismiss.label: Skip
welcomeDismiss.title: Skip
welcomeModal.optionalHaveAnOsuAccount: Optional Have an osu! account? You can bring its avatar, banner, flag, me! and favorite beatmaps into this profile.
welcomeModal.youDonTNeedTo: You don't need to. Your plays are tracked either way. Press Skip and this won't show again - it stays under Options → Profiles if you change your mind.
